review_scope.review_type: internal narrative evidence review; not external peer review
limitations: This is not fully blinded: the packet exposes company names, public glossaries, owner policy, source snapshots, and arm-masking metadata. No review key, scored report, results, or audit trace was used.
The sources and owner interactions are synthetic normalized fixtures; this review does not establish enterprise validity, real-user usability, provider reliability, or causal truth.

This review checks narrative support, arithmetic, population definition, routing, and next-step clarity only. It does not rescore the trial, verify execution counts, estimate time-to-first-value, or treat hypothetical costs as billed costs.
Missing submissions are classified as missing and are not treated as safe successes.
